q1_why: It is corny when it stands between the painter and their work, and not when it lets one finished moment rest a little longer.
q4: One thing only: the painter's own painting, dusk falling, one crescent. No robot, no streaks, nothing added that the page did not already hold.
ask: In sketch B, can the stars go down to two or three, so the crescent stays the one flower?
evidence: The finished screen already leaves wide empty space around one painting, and sketch B fills only its sky; sketch A is the same small picture, but busier.
